name: fables
description: Claude Fables: turns what the agent is doing into little animated cartoons above the prompt, written live by Sonnet or Haiku.

model.title: Scene model
model.description: The model that writes each cartoon scene: Sonnet, or Haiku for quicker, cheaper scenes. /fables model switches it in a session.

terminalArt.title: Terminal art
terminalArt.description: How the terminal draws the cartoon: in half-block cells, or hi-res, the desktop's own art played in headless Chrome and shown as a picture (Ghostty, kitty or WezTerm, also inside tmux with Ghostty or kitty beneath). Hi-res needs Node and Chrome, and uses about half a CPU core while a scene is up.
